 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Partha Sarthy
Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned counsel for the State, learned counsel for the respondent no.5 and learned counsel for the private respondents.

Challenging the order dated 21.1.2012 passed by DLAO, Aurangabad in Misc. Case no.27 of 2011, it is the case of the petitioners that according to the said order, 2.784 acres out of 9.8-1/6 acres is the disputed land.

As such, after exclusion of 2.784 acres, the petitioner is entitled for compensation of 3.267 acres, the respondent no.6 is entitled for compensation of 1.88 acres and the respondent nos.7, 8 and 9 are entitled for compensation of 1.87 acres of land.

However, contrary to the above, the respondent no.6 has received compensation of 3.0184 acres and respondent nos.7, 8 and 9 have received compensation of 3.0184 acres as is evident from the reply received by the respondent under the RTI Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that a rejoinder to the counter-affidavit has been filed.
As the same is not available, the Registry to place the same on record.

It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the Patna High Court CWJC No.11878 of 2016(7)
dt.13-02-2023 private respondents that no further reply requires to be filed to the rejoinder of the petitioners.
Further, learned counsel for the private respondents submits that the order dated 21.1.2012 was the subject matter of CWJC no.5133 of 2012 which was disposed of by order dated 23.4.2012 (Annexure-3).

The award was passed by consent of the parties and against the said award, the proper forum would be reference under section 30 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and as stated in paragraph no.20 of the counter-affidavit filed on behalf of the respondent nos.6 to 9, Reference Case no.151 of 2012 is pending.
Parties to file further affidavits and complete pleadings within one week.
Put up on 22.2.2023 under the heading 'for admission'.

(Partha Sarthy, J) Saurabh/-
